scenes.heading: Building Passive Income With Recurring Affiliate Commissions

sents.d: Building Passive Income With Recurring Affiliate Commissions
How SaaS and subscription affiliate programs let you earn monthly from a single referral.

scenes.heading: Why Recurring Commissions Change the Game

sents.d: Most affiliate programs pay once per sale.
Recurring programs pay you every month the customer stays subscribed.
Refer someone to a $99/month tool with a 30% recurring commission?
That's $29.70/month for as long as they're a customer — potentially years.
Ten referrals like that is nearly $300/month in passive income from ten pieces of content.
ConvertKit (email marketing): 30% recurring.
Teachable (online courses): 30% recurring.
Jasper (AI writing): 30% recurring.
Semrush (SEO tools): 40% recurring — one of the highest.
ClickFunnels: 30% recurring.
HubSpot: varies by product.
The key: only promote tools you actually use and believe in.
Your audience will know if you're just chasing commissions.

scenes.heading: The Math of Stacking Recurring Income

sents.d: Month 1: You refer 5 people across different tools = $150/month.
Month 2: You refer 5 more + previous 5 still paying = $300/month.
Month 6: 30 total referrals, some churn = $600-800/month.
Month 12: 50+ active referrals = $1,500-2,000/month.
This is on top of your one-time commissions.
The compounding effect is real, but it takes consistent content creation over months.
Your recurring income depends on customers staying.
Help them succeed with the product: create tutorials, tips, and guides.
Build a resource page or email sequence for people who sign up through your link.
The better the experience they have, the longer they stay, and the longer you earn.
Some affiliates create entire YouTube playlists teaching people how to use the tools they recommend.
Don't go all-in on recurring and ignore one-time commissions.
The ideal mix: recurring programs for your primary tools (steady base income), high-ticket one-time programs for big paydays, and Amazon/TikTok Shop for easy, frequent small wins.
Diversification protects you if any single program changes its terms or shuts down.

take: Recurring commissions stack into steadier income over time.
